tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There is also mild hypoproteinemia and low ALT. Differential leukocyte count reveals monocytosis, basophilia, and eosinophilia. COVID-19 PCR is negative. Findings may suggest acute or chronic infection, possible bone marrow suppression, or systemic inflammatory process; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
